dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: (The machine rumbles in resentment, indicator lights flickering furiously. But in the end, all of them are extinguished in a final declaration of defeat. This machine is a goner...)

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: They've received some discarded machinery lately. The plan was to dismantle everything and sell the parts, as usual.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: But some would never power off normally. This one kept randomly restarting in the middle of the night.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: They'd clatter all around, terrifying anyone out at night. Someone even got so scared they fell into the water and nearly drowned.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Lyney happened to come by for a magic show, and promised to help them out.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Feels like this should be Freminet's time to shine...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: He only knows how to fix machines so they work. Not how to fix them so they break.

choices.text: You don't have to be so proud of it!

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Anyway, Lyney asked me to come help. He'll be bringing me a cake soon. One machine, one cake.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Mm. Three machines left. Excuse me.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: The reward for the next machine is a berry cake... Mm, berry jam filling, a tart sugar syrup glaze, with a ladyfinger base... and decorated with mint chocolate.

choices.text: "Fix them so they break"? That's... a new one.
